description: This Java source file defines a GUI component 'TableEditorPane' which extends JPanel and handles displaying ECUEditor content within a Swing UI, initializing UI components, and loading controller configuration images.

classes.description: A Swing GUI panel that initializes and displays an ECUEditor component, loading configuration data and managing UI layout.
